title: Qwen3-VL text tower on the llama flow (vision preprocessing in crates/vision-io, the tower only here)

installs.name: qwen38-vision
installs.note: no install on this host today; also MiniCPM-V 4.7 trunk mxfp4 on this flow

installs.name: qwen3vl-4b
installs.note: head_dim 128, 32 q over 8 kv heads; measured 2026-10-29 (text tower only, per the family trap)

recommended.why: the dense chunked driver; the vision encoder is outside the lab's phases, so prefill_tok_s counts text tokens only
default on (llama-flow flip, 2026-10-29): the GQA-shared decode kernel read +19.82% on this install; TURBOSPARK_ATTN_DECODE_KERNEL=barrier restores the old kernel and is the sweep's kill arm

sweeps.description: the batched prefill arm against the per-token loop
the barrier kernel opt-out against the default GQA-shared decode kernel
sweeps.note: the dispatcher falls back to barrier for shapes the GQA-shared kernel does not serve; the engagement line says which ran

findings.conditions: frozen rows; MiniCPM's BF16 matrices refuse the batched arm

findings.workload: tslab ab decode_attention: protocol medium-review, 64 decode, chunk 128; 3 clean pairs, 0 dirty
findings.conditions: decode null floor 0.33% (record 1793263070062-92756-16), effect floor 2.00%; dense_kl; memory growth -0.44 MiB; engagement verified (attn_decode_gqa on every candidate run, attn_decode_barrier on every default run)
findings.note: the strongest of the four legs behind the llama-flow decode default flip (+5.73 mistral7b, +3.93 qwen2, +3.44 qwen3moe, +19.82 here); the profile gains a kill-arm decode_attention sweep with the flip

findings.workload: tslab sweep batched_gemv: protocol long-synthesis, 16 decode, chunk 128; 3 clean pairs, 0 dirty
findings.conditions: prefill null floor 0.18% (record 1793262992496-68855-16), effect floor 2.00%; sweep record 1793263571468-6801-17; dense_kl
findings.note: the chunk-128 batched prefill default stands; the family's first lab-ledger A/Bs

findings.workload: tslab kernel --bench vision_encode, three synthetic pages (512x640, 1024x1280, 1536x1536 -> 1280, 5120, 9216 patches), 5 reps after a discarded cold rep, pread residency
findings.conditions: DIRTY: foreign CPU over 150% (another session's python and GPU parity test); a second run at baf8c514 (record 1793548777344-15491-0, also DIRTY) agreed within 5%
findings.note: compute bound: block reads are 3% or less of the block loop. Block GPU time grows super-linearly with patches (full-page attention), and the dense part runs near 0.4 TFLOP/s on the per-output dot kernel vision_matmul_fp16

findings.workload: tslab kernel --bench ane_matmul vision_qkv/proj/fc1/fc2, programs from bake_ane_vision_programs.py (F16 constants), buckets 1280, 2048, 4096 rows, 5 reps
findings.conditions: eligible (clean host guard), every program planned on the ANE
findings.note: the ane arm includes the activation scale, the output convert and the host handoff; the gpu arm is today's vision_matmul_fp16, a per-output dot kernel, not a matrix-unit GEMM, so the ratio is an upper bound on what the ANE buys

findings.workload: tslab kernel --bench vision_encode, three synthetic pages, 5 reps after a discarded cold rep, arms interleaved mma, per, mma, per
findings.conditions: all four runs DIRTY (a long-running user Python job over 90%); repeats agree within 4.5%; the per arm's record is vision-gemm-per 1793552154700-15631-0
findings.note: vision_matmul_fp16_mma (branch commit f1427d81, not merged into main at the time) runs the projections at 7 to 9.5 TFLOP/s against 0.5 to 0.8; the rest of a large page is the scalar bidirectional attention

findings.workload: tslab kernel --bench ane_matmul vision_qkv/proj/fc1/fc2 with the matrix-unit GEMM as the gpu arm, buckets 1280, 2048, 4096
findings.conditions: eligible; proj at 2048 not loaded (compute plan failed), proj 4096 and fc2 2048 planned on CPU
findings.note: values are ane/gpu; the ANE gate does not pass against a matrix-unit GEMM, so no ANE tower

findings.workload: tslab kernel --bench vision_encode, three synthetic pages, 5 reps after a discarded cold rep, arms interleaved mma, scalar, mma, scalar, GEMM on in both
findings.conditions: all four runs DIRTY (user Python job over 90%, second pair also foreign CPU over 150%); the scalar arm's record is vision-attn-scalar 1793563791518-82359-0; host about 15% slower than the GEMM campaign, so quote ratios
findings.note: vision_attention_bidir_fp16_mma (branch commit 4eadb5ba, not merged into main at the time): 3.2x, 11.4x, 18.1x per page; embeddings agree at mean row cosine 0.99992 or better (the GEMM change's own noise level), greedy transcription byte-identical; peak footprint up about 150 to 200 MiB, unattributed

open_questions: MiniCPM needs a BF16 M-row GEMM before its prefill can batch
the GQA decode default (2026-10-29 flip) rests on timing and 64-token greedy identity only: run a dense_kl gate on qwen3vl-4b with TURBOSPARK_ATTN_DECODE_KERNEL=barrier against unset

what raises vision peak phys_footprint by about 150 to 200 MiB under the flash attention (vision-attn-mma against vision-attn-scalar), and whether 16 query rows per simdgroup or 32-key blocks pay at head_dim 64
traps: the text phases feed no image: prefill_tok_s and a profile measure the text tower only; time the tower with tslab kernel --bench vision_encode (stage ms, block read against block GPU, patches/s, peak footprint), which needs an install streamed with its tower: the qwen3vl-4b catalog row is text-only
